plugin.name: Far Cry Fusion Fix
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the radar and side HUD groups at the screen edges. Choose 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, 32:9 or a custom ratio to keep them in a centered box. Custom ratios are bounded to 4:3–32:9 and the screen width. Changes apply immediately.
FOVFactor.description: Scale the gameplay camera from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 is neutral. The final horizontal view is capped at 150 degrees. Aiming, binoculars, death views and scripted cameras keep their own lens. Changes apply immediately.
SMAA.description: Apply subpixel morphological antialiasing. Requires native MSAA to be disabled.
ConsoleGamma.description: A custom gamma curve for a higher-contrast image with deeper colors, similar to how GTA IV looked on the Xbox 360.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language for Plugins and other plugins. Automatic falls back to English when the game language cannot be identified. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Plugins.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup legal and publisher/engine logo movies. Story movies and the normal options/profile checks remain available.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, framed window or monitor-sized borderless. Changes use the native display reset at the next foreground frame. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the last window mode.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Limit frames per second while playing. 0 is unlimited, -1 follows the monitor refresh rate, and positive values use 30–1000 FPS. Native Vertical Sync can impose a lower limit. Changes apply immediately.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game while its window is unfocused. Turn off to keep the world running in the background. The cursor is released while unfocused. Changes apply immediately.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, ask fusionfix.io whether a newer fix is available and display a notice in Plugins. Off makes no network request.
update.title: Update available
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both preserves the original 4:3 cinematic frame on wide and narrow screens, including the game’s own cinematic bars. Letterbox keeps top and bottom borders, Pillarbox keeps side borders, and Off extends the view without borders. Changes apply immediately.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Slide cinematic borders in and out over a quarter of a second. Turn off for instant borders.
diagnostic.unsupported: This game version is not supported by all features of the fix. Features that could not be installed have been left unchanged. Use the supported patched version of Far Cry.
